content_units: 1. In the movie  Jurassic Park  (1993), what type of dinosaur is the first one the visitors see when they arrive on Isla Nublar? (  Brachiosaurus  )
2. Which 2010 film won the Academy Award for Best Picture and tells the story of King George VI overcoming a speech impediment? (  The King's Speech  )
3. In  Friends , what is the name of Ross and Monica’s sister? (  They do not have a sister  )
4. Which fictional town is the setting for the UK TV comedy  The Office ? (  Slough  )
5. Which band released the 1977 album  Rumours ? (  Fleetwood Mac  )
6. What is the stage name of Reginald Kenneth Dwight? (  Elton John  )
7. How many players from one team are on the court at the same time in a standard basketball game? (  5  )
8. Which country won the FIFA World Cup in 2018? (  France  )
9. What is the capital city of Canada? (  Ottawa  )
10. Which river flows through Budapest, Vienna, and Bratislava? (  Danube  )
11. In which year did the Berlin Wall fall? (  1989  )
12. Which English king had six wives? (  Henry VIII  )
